task_context.problem_statement: In 6 years, Carla will be 30 years old. The sum of the current ages of Carla and Louis is 55. How old is Louis now?
task_context.reference_solution:
Carla is currently 30-6=<<30-6=24>>24 years old.
Louis is 55-24=<<55-24=31>>31 years old at present.
#### 31
